messages.subject: p-value and confidence interval are not consistent
parts:
Hi everyone,
I'm running an actor-partner interdependence model in lavaan. The results overall make sense, but I am wondering about a statistically significant coefficient with a p-value of  < 0.05, but a confidence interval that contains zero (see highlighted in yellow below). I can't figure out whether this is an issue with my model, the data, or something else. Any assistance would be appreciated.

Thank you in advance!

+           flood_W ~ a1*sDpW_W
